==Behind the scenes==
Deema was mentioned in the [[June]] [[2020]] Game Update 6.1.2 of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught]]'', the seventh digital expansion to the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Site">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20190413|text=Announcing 'Onslaught', the Newest Expansion Coming to Star Wars™: The Old Republic™}}</ref>
